newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds steady into weekend.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds steady into weekend.

text.p: Austrian bonds ended the week quietly, taking their cue from international leads. Traders said the tone was slightly softer on the back of U.S. economic data. Turnover low.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down five bps at 100.20 to yield 5.60 (5.59) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.01/11 to yield 5.62/61 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up five bps at 100.15 to yield 4.59 (4.60) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.96/100.06 to yield 4.63/61 percent.
* Austrian bond future down four bps at 110.02 on turnover of 150 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany five bps, five-year spread 19 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.397 and overnight money weaker at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
